name: texture
meaning: the first frame's id-list entry; non-NULL once AnimSprite_InitFromRes found the bitmap group (0x53b5ef stores it, 0x53b672 tests it)

name: frames
meaning: frame table, 4 bytes each: {u16 texPage; u8 u; u8 v}

name: frameCount
meaning: already known; AnimSprite_InitFromRes hard-clamps it to 10 frames

name: width
meaning: frame width in texels, used as the `size` argument to Tex_CornerUV
